parts.tooltip: (a, w1) — a result value a paired with a log fragment w1
(a ⟶ (b, w2)) — given a, produces result b alongside a new log fragment w2
extract a from (a, w1)\napply f(a) to get (b, w2)\nreturn (b, w1 <> w2)  ← logs combined with monoid append
(b, w1<>w2) — result b with the complete log: w1 from the first step appended with w2 from f
